description: This header file defines interfaces and structures for handling chunked file formats, including initialization, reading, writing, and locating chunks within a file. It appears to be part of a larger system that manages data stored in a chunked format, with functions to pair and read specific chunks.

methods.name: init_chunkfile
methods.description: Initializes a 'struct chunkfile' for reading or writing a chunked file format.

methods.name: free_chunkfile
methods.description: Frees the resources associated with a 'struct chunkfile'.

methods.name: get_num_chunks
methods.description: Returns the number of chunks in the 'struct chunkfile'.

methods.name: add_chunk
methods.description: Adds a chunk to the chunkfile with a specific ID, size, and write function.

methods.name: write_chunkfile
methods.description: Writes out the entire chunkfile with provided data.

methods.name: read_table_of_contents
methods.description: Reads the table of contents (TOC) at a specified offset in a memory-mapped file.

methods.name: pair_chunk
methods.description: Locates a chunk by ID and provides a pointer to its start and size.

methods.name: read_chunk
methods.description: Finds and processes a chunk using a callback function.

methods.name: oid_version
methods.description: Returns the version of the object ID algorithm used.

ctags.name: chunk_read_fn
ctags.typeref: typename:int (*)(const unsigned char * chunk_start,size_t chunk_size,void * data)
